---
title: "World Cup Predictor Dataset Build"
format: pdf
---




```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(worldcup)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 1: Historical World Cup Win Rate Difference
# ============================================================

# Men's World Cup tournaments
mens_tournaments <- tournaments |>
  filter(
    str_detect(
      tournament_name,
      "Men's World Cup"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    tournament_id,
    year,
    start_date
  )


# Men's World Cup matches
matches <- worldcup::matches |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments,
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  select(
    tournament_id,
    year,
    match_id,
    match_date,
    home_team_code,
    home_team_name,
    away_team_code,
    away_team_name,
    home_team_score,
    away_team_score
  )


# One row per team per match
team_match_history <- bind_rows(

  matches |>
    transmute(
      tournament_id,
      year,
      match_id,
      match_date,
      team_code = home_team_code,
      team_name = home_team_name,
      goals_for = home_team_score,
      goals_against = away_team_score,
      win = as.integer(
        home_team_score > away_team_score
      )
    ),

  matches |>
    transmute(
      tournament_id,
      year,
      match_id,
      match_date,
      team_code = away_team_code,
      team_name = away_team_name,
      goals_for = away_team_score,
      goals_against = home_team_score,
      win = as.integer(
        away_team_score > home_team_score
      )
    )
)


# Teams appearing in each World Cup
teams_by_tournament <- team_match_history |>
  distinct(
    year,
    team_code,
    team_name
  )


# Historical World Cup win rate before each tournament
wc_win_rate_by_tournament <- map_dfr(
  sort(unique(teams_by_tournament$year)),
  function(target_year) {

    current_teams <- teams_by_tournament |>
      filter(year == target_year)

    prior_history <- team_match_history |>
      filter(year < target_year)

    current_teams |>
      left_join(
        prior_history |>
          group_by(team_code) |>
          summarise(
            prior_wc_matches = n(),
            prior_wc_wins = sum(win),
            .groups = "drop"
          ),
        by = "team_code"
      ) |>
      mutate(
        prior_wc_matches =
          replace_na(
            prior_wc_matches,
            0L
          ),

        prior_wc_wins =
          replace_na(
            prior_wc_wins,
            0
          ),

        wc_win_rate = if_else(
          prior_wc_matches > 0,
          prior_wc_wins / prior_wc_matches,
          0
        )
      ) |>
      select(
        year,
        team_code,
        wc_win_rate
      )
  }
)


# Home-team win rate
home_wc_win_rate <- wc_win_rate_by_tournament |>
  rename(
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_wc_win_rate = wc_win_rate
  )


# Away-team win rate
away_wc_win_rate <- wc_win_rate_by_tournament |>
  rename(
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_wc_win_rate = wc_win_rate
  )


# Add Predictor 1
world_cup_data <- matches |>
  left_join(
    home_wc_win_rate,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_wc_win_rate,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    wc_win_rate_diff =
      home_wc_win_rate -
      away_wc_win_rate
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 5: Previous World Cup Finish Difference
# ============================================================

# Add winner information to each tournament team
team_tournament_results <- qualified_teams |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments |>
      left_join(
        tournaments |>
          select(
            tournament_id,
            winner
          ),
        by = "tournament_id"
      ),
    by = "tournament_id"
  )


# Score each team's finish in every World Cup
finish_history <- team_tournament_results |>
  mutate(
    performance_clean =
      str_to_lower(performance),

    finish_score = case_when(

      team_name == winner ~ 6,

      performance_clean == "final" ~ 5,

      str_detect(
        performance_clean,
        "semi|third"
      ) ~ 4,

      str_detect(
        performance_clean,
        "quarter"
      ) ~ 3,

      str_detect(
        performance_clean,
        "round of sixteen|round of 16|second round|second group"
      ) ~ 2,

      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    team_code,
    year,
    finish_score
  )


# Previous World Cup finish for each team
previous_finish_by_tournament <- teams_by_tournament |>
  mutate(
    previous_year = year - 4
  ) |>
  left_join(
    finish_history,
    by = c(
      "team_code",
      "previous_year" = "year"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    previous_finish =
      replace_na(
        finish_score,
        0
      )
  ) |>
  select(
    year,
    team_code,
    previous_finish
  )


# Home-team previous finish
home_previous_finish <- previous_finish_by_tournament |>
  rename(
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_previous_finish = previous_finish
  )


# Away-team previous finish
away_previous_finish <- previous_finish_by_tournament |>
  rename(
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_previous_finish = previous_finish
  )


# Add Predictor 5
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_previous_finish,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_previous_finish,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    previous_finish_diff =
      home_previous_finish -
      away_previous_finish
  )  
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 6: Historical World Cup Head-to-Head Win Percentage
# ============================================================

# One row per team/opponent matchup
h2h_history <- bind_rows(

  matches |>
    transmute(
      year,
      team_code = home_team_code,
      opponent_code = away_team_code,
      win = as.integer(
        home_team_score > away_team_score
      )
    ),

  matches |>
    transmute(
      year,
      team_code = away_team_code,
      opponent_code = home_team_code,
      win = as.integer(
        away_team_score > home_team_score
      )
    )
)


# Historical H2H record frozen before each World Cup
h2h_by_tournament <- map_dfr(
  sort(unique(matches$year)),
  function(target_year) {

    current_matches <- matches |>
      filter(year == target_year) |>
      distinct(
        year,
        home_team_code,
        away_team_code
      )

    prior_h2h <- h2h_history |>
      filter(year < target_year) |>
      group_by(
        team_code,
        opponent_code
      ) |>
      summarise(
        h2h_matches = n(),
        h2h_wins = sum(win),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    current_matches |>
      left_join(
        prior_h2h,
        by = c(
          "home_team_code" = "team_code",
          "away_team_code" = "opponent_code"
        )
      ) |>
      mutate(
        h2h_matches =
          replace_na(
            h2h_matches,
            0L
          ),

        h2h_wins =
          replace_na(
            h2h_wins,
            0
          ),

        h2h_win_pct = if_else(
          h2h_matches > 0,
          h2h_wins / h2h_matches,
          0.5
        )
      ) |>
      select(
        year,
        home_team_code,
        away_team_code,
        h2h_win_pct
      )
  }
)


# Add Predictor 6
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    h2h_by_tournament,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "home_team_code",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 8: Host Advantage
# ============================================================

host_teams <- host_countries |>
  semi_join(
    mens_tournaments,
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  select(
    tournament_id,
    team_code
  ) |>
  distinct()


# Home-team host indicator
home_host <- host_teams |>
  transmute(
    tournament_id,
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_is_host = 1
  )


# Away-team host indicator
away_host <- host_teams |>
  transmute(
    tournament_id,
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_is_host = 1
  )


# Add Predictor 8
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_host,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_host,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    home_is_host = replace_na(home_is_host, 0),
    away_is_host = replace_na(away_is_host, 0),

    host_advantage =
      home_is_host -
      away_is_host
  )
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# Predictor 12: Average Squad Age Difference
# ============================================================

squad_age <- squads |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments |>
      select(
        tournament_id,
        start_date
      ),
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    players |>
      select(
        player_id,
        birth_date
      ),
    by = "player_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    start_date = as.Date(start_date),
    birth_date = as.Date(birth_date),

    age = as.numeric(
      start_date - birth_date
    ) / 365.25
  ) |>
  group_by(
    tournament_id,
    team_code
  ) |>
  summarise(
    avg_squad_age = mean(
      age,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Home-team squad age
home_squad_age <- squad_age |>
  rename(
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_avg_squad_age = avg_squad_age
  )


# Away-team squad age
away_squad_age <- squad_age |>
  rename(
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_avg_squad_age = avg_squad_age
  )


# Add Predictor 12
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_squad_age,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_squad_age,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    avg_squad_age_diff =
      home_avg_squad_age -
      away_avg_squad_age
  )

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 13: Squad World Cup Experience Difference
# ============================================================

# Count WC matches played by each player
# in each tournament
player_wc_apps <- player_appearances |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments |>
      select(
        tournament_id,
        year
      ),
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  count(
    player_id,
    tournament_id,
    year,
    name = "wc_match_apps"
  )


# Previous WC experience for every squad player
player_tournament_history <- squads |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments |>
      select(
        tournament_id,
        year
      ),
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  distinct(
    player_id,
    tournament_id,
    year,
    team_code
  ) |>
  left_join(
    player_wc_apps,
    by = c(
      "player_id",
      "tournament_id",
      "year"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    wc_match_apps =
      replace_na(
        wc_match_apps,
        0
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(player_id) |>
  arrange(
    year,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prior_player_wc_apps =
      lag(
        cumsum(wc_match_apps),
        default = 0
      )
  ) |>
  ungroup()


# Average previous WC experience for each squad
squad_experience <- player_tournament_history |>
  group_by(
    tournament_id,
    team_code
  ) |>
  summarise(
    squad_wc_experience =
      mean(prior_player_wc_apps),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Home-team squad experience
home_squad_experience <- squad_experience |>
  rename(
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_squad_wc_experience =
      squad_wc_experience
  )


# Away-team squad experience
away_squad_experience <- squad_experience |>
  rename(
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_squad_wc_experience =
      squad_wc_experience
  )


# Add Predictor 13
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_squad_experience,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_squad_experience,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    squad_wc_experience_diff =
      home_squad_wc_experience -
      away_squad_wc_experience
  )
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 14: Pre-Tournament Elo Difference
# ============================================================

# Clean team names for Elo matching
elo_team_key <- function(x) {

  x <- x |>
    str_squish() |>
    stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ") |>
    str_squish()

  case_when(
    x %in% c(
      "usa",
      "united states of america"
    ) ~ "united states",

    x %in% c(
      "korea republic",
      "republic of korea"
    ) ~ "south korea",

    x == "ir iran" ~ "iran",

    x %in% c(
      "cote d ivoire",
      "ivory coast"
    ) ~ "ivory coast",

    x == "turkiye" ~ "turkey",

    x == "czechia" ~ "czech republic",

    x == "china pr" ~ "china",

    x == "cabo verde" ~ "cape verde",

    x %in% c(
      "congo dr",
      "dr congo"
    ) ~ "dr congo",

    x == "republic of ireland" ~ "ireland",
    
    x == "west germany" ~ "germany",

    TRUE ~ x
  )
}


# Function to get Elo ratings for one date
get_frozen_elo <- function(date) {

  date <- as.Date(date)

  url <- paste0(
    "https://www.international-football.net/elo-ratings-table?",
    "year=", lubridate::year(date),
    "&month=", sprintf(
      "%02d",
      lubridate::month(date)
    ),
    "&day=", sprintf(
      "%02d",
      lubridate::day(date)
    )
  )

  rows <- read_html(url) |>
    html_elements("table tr")

  map_dfr(
    rows,
    function(row) {

      cells <- row |>
        html_elements("td") |>
        html_text2()

      if (length(cells) < 3) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      rating <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          str_extract(
            cells[length(cells)],
            "\\d{3,4}"
          )
        )
      )

      team <- cells[length(cells) - 1]

      if (
        is.na(rating) ||
        team == "" ||
        !str_detect(team, "[A-Za-z]")
      ) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      tibble(
        team_key = elo_team_key(team),
        elo = rating
      )
    }
  ) |>
    distinct(
      team_key,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
}


# Elo snapshot from the day before each World Cup
elo_snapshots <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(mens_tournaments)),
  function(i) {

    target_year <-
      mens_tournaments$year[i]

    snapshot_date <-
      as.Date(
        mens_tournaments$start_date[i]
      ) - 1

    get_frozen_elo(snapshot_date) |>
      mutate(
        year = target_year
      )
  }
)


# Home-team Elo
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 15: Average International Caps Difference
# ============================================================

# Clean team names for matching
clean_caps_name <- function(x) {

  x <- str_squish(x)

  case_when(
    x == "China PR" ~ "China",

    x %in% c(
      "Korea Republic",
      "Republic of Korea"
    ) ~ "South Korea",

    x == "IR Iran" ~ "Iran",

    x == "United States of America" ~ "United States",

    x %in% c(
      "Côte d'Ivoire",
      "Ivory Coast"
    ) ~ "Ivory Coast",

    x == "Türkiye" ~ "Turkey",

    x == "Czechia" ~ "Czech Republic",

    x %in% c(
      "FR Yugoslavia",
      "Yugoslavia (FR Yugoslavia)"
    ) ~ "Yugoslavia",

    TRUE ~ x
  )
}


# Function to scrape squad caps for one World Cup
scrape_wc_caps <- function(year) {

  url <- paste0(
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/",
    year,
    "_FIFA_World_Cup_squads"
  )

  page <- read_html(url)

  headings <- page |>
    html_elements("h3")

  map_dfr(
    headings,
    function(h) {

      team <- h |>
        html_text2() |>
        str_remove("\\[edit\\]$") |>
        str_squish()

      table_node <- xml2::xml_find_first(
        h,
        "following::table[1]"
      )

      if (inherits(table_node, "xml_missing")) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      tbl <- tryCatch(
        html_table(
          table_node,
          fill = TRUE
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(tbl)) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      column_names <- names(tbl)

      caps_col <- column_names[
        str_detect(
          str_to_lower(column_names),
          "caps"
        )
      ]

      player_col <- column_names[
        str_detect(
          str_to_lower(column_names),
          "player"
        )
      ]

      if (
        length(caps_col) == 0 |
        length(player_col) == 0
      ) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      tibble(
        year = year,
        team_name = team,
        player = tbl[[player_col[1]]],
        caps = parse_number(
          as.character(
            tbl[[caps_col[1]]]
          )
        )
      ) |>
        filter(
          !is.na(player),
          player != "",
          !is.na(caps)
        )
    }
  )
}


# Get squad caps for the World Cups in our data
caps_years <- sort(
  unique(world_cup_data$year)
)

squad_caps_raw <- map_dfr(
  caps_years,
  scrape_wc_caps
)


# Average caps for each team
squad_caps_by_team <- squad_caps_raw |>
  mutate(
    team_clean =
      clean_caps_name(team_name)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    year,
    team_clean
  ) |>
  summarise(
    avg_caps =
      mean(
        caps,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Home-team average caps
home_caps <- squad_caps_by_team |>
  rename(
    home_team_name = team_clean,
    home_avg_caps = avg_caps

# Away-team average caps

# Add Predictor 15

  left_join(
    home_caps,

      "year",

    )
  ) |>
  left_join(

      "year",

  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 16: Qualification Performance Difference
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Download international match results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

international_results <- read_csv(
  paste0(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
    "martj42/international_results/",
    "master/results.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Historical team-name mappings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

former_names <- read_csv(
  paste0(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
    "martj42/international_results/",
    "master/former_names.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


former_lookup <- setNames(
  former_names$current,
  former_names$former
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean qualification team names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_qual_name <- function(x) {

  x <- str_squish(x)

  x <- case_when(

    x == "IR Iran" ~ "Iran",

    x %in% c(
      "Korea Republic",
      "Republic of Korea"
    ) ~ "South Korea",

    x == "Côte d'Ivoire" ~ "Ivory Coast",

    x == "Türkiye" ~ "Turkey",

    TRUE ~ x
  )

  idx <- match(
    x,
    names(former_lookup)
  )

  replace_rows <- !is.na(idx)

  x[replace_rows] <-
    unname(
      former_lookup[
        idx[replace_rows]
      ]
    )

  x
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# World Cup start dates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_wc_starts <- mens_tournaments |>
  transmute(
    wc_year = year,
    wc_start = as.Date(start_date)
  ) |>
  arrange(wc_start)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Assign qualification matches to the next World Cup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

find_next_world_cup <- function(match_dates) {

  map_dbl(
    match_dates,
    function(d) {

      next_index <- which(
        all_wc_starts$wc_start > d
      )[1]

      if (is.na(next_index)) {
        return(NA_real_)
      }

      all_wc_starts$wc_year[
        next_index
      ]
    }
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Keep World Cup qualification matches
#
# CONCACAF Championship is included because the
# 1989 tournament served as qualification for 1990
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qual_matches <- international_results |>
  filter(
    tournament %in% c(
      "FIFA World Cup qualification",
      "CONCACAF Championship"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    wc_year =
      find_next_world_cup(date)
  ) |>
  filter(
    wc_year %in%
      unique(world_cup_data$year)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# One row per team per qualifying match
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qual_team_matches <- bind_rows(

  qual_matches |>
    transmute(
      wc_year,
      team_name = home_team,
      goals_for = home_score,
      goals_against = away_score
    ),

  qual_matches |>
    transmute(
      wc_year,
      team_name = away_team,
      goals_for = away_score,
      goals_against = home_score
    )

) |>
  mutate(
    team_clean =
      clean_qual_name(team_name),

    win = as.integer(
      goals_for > goals_against
    ),

    draw = as.integer(
      goals_for == goals_against
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Qualification performance by team
#
# 1 = perfect qualifying record
# 0 = lost every qualifying match
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qualification_by_team <- qual_team_matches |>
  group_by(
    wc_year,
    team_clean
  ) |>
  summarise(
    qual_matches = n(),

    qual_wins = sum(win),

    qual_draws = sum(draw),

    qualification_perf =
      (
        3 * qual_wins +
        qual_draws
      ) /
      (
        3 * qual_matches
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Automatic qualifiers
#
# Neutral qualification performance = 0.5
# ------------------------------------------------------------

automatic_qualifiers <- tribble(
  ~wc_year, ~team_name,

  1990, "Italy",
  1990, "Argentina",

  1994, "United States",
  1994, "Germany",

  1998, "France",
  1998, "Brazil",

  2002, "South Korea",
  2002, "Japan",
  2002, "France",

  2006, "Germany",

  2010, "South Africa",

  2014, "Brazil",

  2018, "Russia",

  2022, "Qatar"
) |>
  mutate(
    team_clean =
      clean_qual_name(team_name),

    qualification_perf = 0.5
  ) |>
  select(
    wc_year,
    team_clean,
    qualification_perf
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add automatic qualifiers
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qualification_by_team <- qualification_by_team |>
  select(
    wc_year,
    team_clean,
    qualification_perf
  ) |>
  anti_join(
    automatic_qualifiers,
    by = c(
      "wc_year",
      "team_clean"
    )
  ) |>
  bind_rows(
    automatic_qualifiers
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove old Predictor 16 columns if rerunning
# ------------------------------------------------------------

world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  select(
    -any_of(
      c(
        "home_qualification_perf",
        "away_qualification_perf",
        "qualification_perf_diff",
        "qual_home_key",
        "qual_away_key",
        "home_qual_key",
        "away_qual_key"
      )
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create matching keys
# ------------------------------------------------------------

world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  mutate(

    qual_home_key = case_when(

      year == 1990 &
        home_team_name == "West Germany" ~
        "Germany",

      year == 1990 &
        home_team_name == "Soviet Union" ~
        "Russia",

      year == 1998 &
        home_team_name == "Yugoslavia" ~
        "Serbia",

      year == 2006 &
        home_team_name ==
        "Serbia and Montenegro" ~
        "Serbia",

      TRUE ~
        clean_qual_name(
          home_team_name
        )
    ),

    qual_away_key = case_when(

      year == 1990 &
        away_team_name == "West Germany" ~
        "Germany",

      year == 1990 &
        away_team_name == "Soviet Union" ~
        "Russia",

      year == 1998 &
        away_team_name == "Yugoslavia" ~
        "Serbia",

      year == 2006 &
        away_team_name ==
        "Serbia and Montenegro" ~
        "Serbia",

      TRUE ~
        clean_qual_name(
          away_team_name
        )
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Home qualification performance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

home_qualification <- qualification_by_team |>
  select(
    year = wc_year,
    qual_home_key = team_clean,
    home_qualification_perf =
      qualification_perf
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Away qualification performance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

away_qualification <- qualification_by_team |>
  select(
    year = wc_year,
    qual_away_key = team_clean,
    away_qualification_perf =
      qualification_perf
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add Predictor 16
# ------------------------------------------------------------

world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_qualification,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "qual_home_key"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_qualification,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "qual_away_key"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    qualification_perf_diff =
      home_qualification_perf -
      away_qualification_perf
  )

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# BUILD 2026 WORLD CUP DATA + FINAL DATASET
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Helper for matching 2026 team names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

normalize_2026_team <- function(x) {

  x <- x |>
    str_squish() |>
    stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ") |>
    str_squish()

  case_when(

    x %in% c(
      "usa",
      "united states of america"
    ) ~ "united states",

    x %in% c(
      "korea republic",
      "republic of korea"
    ) ~ "south korea",

    x == "ir iran" ~ "iran",

    x == "republic of ireland" ~ "ireland",

    x %in% c(
      "cote d ivoire",
      "ivory coast"
    ) ~ "ivory coast",

    x == "turkiye" ~ "turkey",

    x == "czechia" ~ "czech republic",

    x == "cabo verde" ~ "cape verde",

    x %in% c(
      "congo dr",
      "dr congo",
      "dem rep of congo",
      "democratic republic of congo",
      "democratic republic of the congo",
      "congo kinshasa",
      "zaire"
    ) ~ "dr congo",

    TRUE ~ x
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Download 2026 World Cup data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wc26_base <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "stiles/world-cup/",
  "refs/heads/main/",
  "data/processed/2026/"
)

wc26_results <- read_csv(
  paste0(
    wc26_base,
    "results.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

wc26_schedule <- read_csv(
  paste0(
    wc26_base,
    "schedule.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

wc26_teams <- read_csv(
  paste0(
    wc26_base,
    "teams.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

wc26_players <- read_csv(
  paste0(
    wc26_base,
    "players.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Base 2026 match table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wc26_matches <- wc26_results |>
  left_join(
    wc26_schedule |>
      select(
        id_match,
        local_date
      ),
    by = "id_match"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    tournament_id = "WC-2026",

    year = 2026,

    match_id = paste0(
      "M-2026-",
      str_pad(
        match_number,
        width = 3,
        pad = "0"
      )
    ),

    match_date =
      as.Date(local_date),

    home_team_code =
      home_team,

    home_team_name =
      home_name,

    away_team_code =
      away_team,

    away_team_name =
      away_name,

    home_team_score =
      home_score,

    away_team_score =
      away_score,

    match_result = case_when(
      home_score > away_score ~
        "Home Win",

      home_score < away_score ~
        "Away Win",

      TRUE ~
        "Draw"
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Match 2026 teams to historical World Cup teams
# ------------------------------------------------------------

historical_team_lookup <- teams |>
  mutate(
    team_key =
      normalize_2026_team(
        team_name
      )
  ) |>
  select(
    team_key,
    history_code = team_code
  ) |>
  distinct(
    team_key,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


wc26_team_lookup <- wc26_teams |>
  mutate(
    team_key =
      normalize_2026_team(
        team_name
      )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    historical_team_lookup,
    by = "team_key"
  ) |>
  mutate(

    history_code = case_when(

      team_key ==
        "dr congo" ~ "COD",

      TRUE ~ history_code
    ),

    history_code = coalesce(
      history_code,
      paste0(
        "NEW_",
        abbreviation
      )
    )
  )


# Add historical codes to match table
wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    wc26_team_lookup |>
      select(
        home_team_code = abbreviation,
        home_history_code =
          history_code
      ),
    by = "home_team_code"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    wc26_team_lookup |>
      select(
        away_team_code = abbreviation,
        away_history_code =
          history_code
      ),
    by = "away_team_code"
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTORS 1-4
# HISTORICAL WORLD CUP PERFORMANCE
# Frozen using matches through 2022
# ============================================================

wc26_history <- team_match_history |>
  group_by(
    team_code
  ) |>
  summarise(
    prior_wc_matches = n(),

    prior_wc_wins =
      sum(win),

    prior_wc_gf =
      sum(goals_for),

    prior_wc_ga =
      sum(goals_against),

    prior_wc_appearances =
      n_distinct(year),

    wc_win_rate =
      prior_wc_wins /
      prior_wc_matches,

    wc_gf_pg =
      prior_wc_gf /
      prior_wc_matches,

    wc_ga_pg =
      prior_wc_ga /
      prior_wc_matches,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


wc26_home_history <- wc26_history |>
  rename(
    home_history_code =
      team_code,

    home_wc_win_rate =
      wc_win_rate,

    home_wc_gf_pg =
      wc_gf_pg,

    home_wc_ga_pg =
      wc_ga_pg,

    home_wc_appearances =
      prior_wc_appearances
  )


wc26_away_history <- wc26_history |>
  rename(
    away_history_code =
      team_code,

    away_wc_win_rate =
      wc_win_rate,

    away_wc_gf_pg =
      wc_gf_pg,

    away_wc_ga_pg =
      wc_ga_pg,

    away_wc_appearances =
      prior_wc_appearances
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    wc26_home_history,
    by = "home_history_code"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    wc26_away_history,
    by = "away_history_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        home_wc_win_rate,
        home_wc_gf_pg,
        home_wc_ga_pg,
        home_wc_appearances,
        away_wc_win_rate,
        away_wc_gf_pg,
        away_wc_ga_pg,
        away_wc_appearances
      ),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
    ),

    wc_win_rate_diff =
      home_wc_win_rate -
      away_wc_win_rate,

    wc_gf_pg_diff =
      home_wc_gf_pg -
      away_wc_gf_pg,

    wc_ga_pg_diff =
      home_wc_ga_pg -
      away_wc_ga_pg,

    wc_appearances_diff =
      home_wc_appearances -
      away_wc_appearances
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTOR 5
# PREVIOUS WORLD CUP FINISH
# ============================================================

wc2022_id <- mens_tournaments |>
  filter(
    year == 2022
  ) |>
  pull(tournament_id)


wc2022_winner <- tournaments |>
  filter(
    tournament_id ==
      wc2022_id
  ) |>
  pull(winner)


previous_finish_2022 <- qualified_teams |>
  filter(
    tournament_id ==
      wc2022_id
  ) |>
  mutate(
    performance_clean =
      str_to_lower(
        performance
      ),

    previous_finish =
      case_when(

        team_name ==
          wc2022_winner ~ 6,

        performance_clean ==
          "final" ~ 5,

        str_detect(
          performance_clean,
          "semi|third"
        ) ~ 4,

        str_detect(
          performance_clean,
          "quarter"
        ) ~ 3,

        str_detect(
          performance_clean,
          "round of 16|round of sixteen"
        ) ~ 2,

        TRUE ~ 1
      )
  ) |>
  select(
    team_code,
    previous_finish
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    previous_finish_2022 |>
      rename(
        home_history_code =
          team_code,

        home_previous_finish =
          previous_finish
      ),
    by = "home_history_code"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    previous_finish_2022 |>
      rename(
        away_history_code =
          team_code,

        away_previous_finish =
          previous_finish
      ),
    by = "away_history_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    home_previous_finish =
      replace_na(
        home_previous_finish,
        0
      ),

    away_previous_finish =
      replace_na(
        away_previous_finish,
        0
      ),

    previous_finish_diff =
      home_previous_finish -
      away_previous_finish
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTORS 6-7
# HISTORICAL WORLD CUP HEAD-TO-HEAD
# Frozen before 2026
# ============================================================

mens_wc_ids <- mens_tournaments |>
  pull(tournament_id)


wc26_h2h_history <- team_appearances |>
  filter(
    tournament_id %in%
      mens_wc_ids
  ) |>
  group_by(
    team_code,
    opponent_code
  ) |>
  summarise(
    h2h_matches = n(),

    h2h_wins =
      sum(win),

    h2h_win_pct =
      h2h_wins /
      h2h_matches,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    wc26_h2h_history,
    by = c(
      "home_history_code" =
        "team_code",

      "away_history_code" =
        "opponent_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    h2h_matches =
      replace_na(
        h2h_matches,
        0
      ),

    h2h_win_pct =
      replace_na(
        h2h_win_pct,
        0.5
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTORS 8-11
# HOST, CONFEDERATION, DEFENDING CHAMPION
# ============================================================

wc26_context <- wc26_team_lookup |>
  transmute(
    team_code =
      abbreviation,

    confederation =
      confederation,

    is_host =
      as.integer(
        abbreviation %in%
          c(
            "CAN",
            "MEX",
            "USA"
          )
      ),

    is_defending_champion =
      as.integer(
        abbreviation ==
          "ARG"
      )
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    wc26_context |>
      rename(
        home_team_code =
          team_code,

        home_confederation =
          confederation,

        home_is_host =
          is_host,

        home_defending_champion =
          is_defending_champion
      ),
    by = "home_team_code"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    wc26_context |>
      rename(
        away_team_code =
          team_code,

        away_confederation =
          confederation,

        away_is_host =
          is_host,

        away_defending_champion =
          is_defending_champion
      ),
    by = "away_team_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    host_advantage =
      home_is_host -
      away_is_host,

    defending_champion_diff =
      home_defending_champion -
      away_defending_champion
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTOR 12
# AVERAGE SQUAD AGE
# ============================================================

wc26_squad_age <- wc26_players |>
  mutate(
    birth_date =
      as.Date(dob),

    age =
      as.numeric(
        as.Date(
          "2026-06-11"
        ) -
        birth_date
      ) /
      365.25
  ) |>
  group_by(
    team_abbr
  ) |>
  summarise(
    avg_squad_age =
      mean(
        age,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    wc26_squad_age |>
      rename(
        home_team_code =
          team_abbr,

        home_avg_squad_age =
          avg_squad_age
      ),
    by = "home_team_code"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    wc26_squad_age |>
      rename(
        away_team_code =
          team_abbr,

        away_avg_squad_age =
          avg_squad_age
      ),
    by = "away_team_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    avg_squad_age_diff =
      home_avg_squad_age -
      away_avg_squad_age
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTOR 13
# SQUAD WORLD CUP EXPERIENCE
# ============================================================

prior_player_wc_apps <- player_appearances |>
  filter(
    tournament_id %in%
      mens_wc_ids
  ) |>
  count(
    player_id,
    team_code,
    name = "prior_wc_apps"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    players |>
      select(
        player_id,
        birth_date
      ),
    by = "player_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    birth_date =
      as.Date(
        birth_date
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    team_code,
    birth_date
  ) |>
  summarise(
    prior_wc_apps =
      max(
        prior_wc_apps
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


wc26_squad_experience <- wc26_players |>
  mutate(
    birth_date =
      as.Date(dob)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    wc26_team_lookup |>
      select(
        team_abbr =
          abbreviation,

        history_code
      ),
    by = "team_abbr"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    prior_player_wc_apps,
    by = c(
      "history_code" =
        "team_code",

      "birth_date"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prior_wc_apps =
      replace_na(
        prior_wc_apps,
        0
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    team_abbr
  ) |>
  summarise(
    squad_wc_experience =
      mean(
        prior_wc_apps
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    wc26_squad_experience |>
      rename(
        home_team_code =
          team_abbr,

        home_squad_wc_experience =
          squad_wc_experience
      ),
    by = "home_team_code"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    wc26_squad_experience |>
      rename(
        away_team_code =
          team_abbr,

        away_squad_wc_experience =
          squad_wc_experience
      ),
    by = "away_team_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    squad_wc_experience_diff =
      home_squad_wc_experience -
      away_squad_wc_experience
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTOR 14
# PRE-TOURNAMENT ELO
#
# Freeze Elo on June 10, 2026
# ============================================================

elo_2026 <- get_frozen_elo(
  as.Date(
    "2026-06-10"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    team_key =
      normalize_2026_team(
        team_key
      )
  ) |>
  distinct(
    team_key,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  mutate(
    home_team_key =
      normalize_2026_team(
        home_team_name
      ),

    away_team_key =
      normalize_2026_team(
        away_team_name
      )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    elo_2026 |>
      select(
        home_team_key =
          team_key,

        home_elo =
          elo
      ),
    by = "home_team_key"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    elo_2026 |>
      select(
        away_team_key =
          team_key,

        away_elo =
          elo
      ),
    by = "away_team_key"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    elo_diff =
      home_elo -
      away_elo
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTOR 15
# AVERAGE INTERNATIONAL CAPS
# ============================================================

caps_2026 <- scrape_wc_caps(
  2026
) |>
  mutate(
    team_key =
      normalize_2026_team(
        team_name
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    team_key
  ) |>
  summarise(
    avg_caps =
      mean(
        caps,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    caps_2026 |>
      select(
        home_team_key =
          team_key,

        home_avg_caps =
          avg_caps
      ),
    by = "home_team_key"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    caps_2026 |>
      select(
        away_team_key =
          team_key,

        away_avg_caps =
          avg_caps
      ),
    by = "away_team_key"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    avg_caps_diff =
      home_avg_caps -
      away_avg_caps
  )


# ============================================================
# PREDICTORS 16-17
# 2026 QUALIFICATION PERFORMANCE
# ============================================================

qual26_matches <- international_results |>
  filter(
    date >
      as.Date(
        "2022-12-18"
      ),

    date <
      as.Date(
        "2026-06-11"
      ),

    tournament ==
      "FIFA World Cup qualification"
  )


qual26_team_matches <- bind_rows(

  qual26_matches |>
    transmute(
      team_key =
        normalize_2026_team(
          home_team
        ),

      goals_for =
        home_score,

      goals_against =
        away_score
    ),

  qual26_matches |>
    transmute(
      team_key =
        normalize_2026_team(
          away_team
        ),

      goals_for =
        away_score,

      goals_against =
        home_score
    )

) |>
  mutate(
    win =
      as.integer(
        goals_for >
        goals_against
      ),

    draw =
      as.integer(
        goals_for ==
        goals_against
      )
  )


qualification_2026 <- qual26_team_matches |>
  group_by(
    team_key
  ) |>
  summarise(
    qual_matches = n(),

    qual_wins =
      sum(win),

    qual_draws =
      sum(draw),

    qual_gf =
      sum(goals_for),

    qual_ga =
      sum(goals_against),

    qualification_perf =
      (
        3 * qual_wins +
        qual_draws
      ) /
      (
        3 * qual_matches
      ),

    qualification_gd =
      (
        qual_gf -
        qual_ga
      ) /
      qual_matches,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Hosts automatically qualified
automatic_2026 <- tibble(
  team_key =
    normalize_2026_team(
      c(
        "Canada",
        "Mexico",
        "United States"
      )
    ),

  qualification_perf =
    0.5,

  qualification_gd =
    0
)


qualification_2026 <- qualification_2026 |>
  anti_join(
    automatic_2026,
    by = "team_key"
  ) |>
  bind_rows(
    automatic_2026
  )


wc26_matches <- wc26_matches |>
  left_join(
    qualification_2026 |>
      select(
        home_team_key =
          team_key,

        home_qualification_perf =
          qualification_perf,

        home_qualification_gd =
          qualification_gd
      ),
    by = "home_team_key"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    qualification_2026 |>
      select(
        away_team_key =
          team_key,

        away_qualification_perf =
          qualification_perf,

        away_qualification_gd =
          qualification_gd
      ),
    by = "away_team_key"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    qualification_perf_diff =
      home_qualification_perf -
      away_qualification_perf,

    qualification_gd_diff =
      home_qualification_gd -
      away_qualification_gd
  )


# ============================================================
# FINAL 2026 DATA
# ============================================================

predictors <- c(
  "wc_win_rate_diff",
  "wc_gf_pg_diff",
  "wc_ga_pg_diff",
  "wc_appearances_diff",
  "previous_finish_diff",
  "h2h_win_pct",
  "h2h_matches",
  "host_advantage",
  "home_confederation",
  "away_confederation",
  "defending_champion_diff",
  "avg_squad_age_diff",
  "squad_wc_experience_diff",
  "elo_diff",
  "avg_caps_diff",
  "qualification_perf_diff",
  "qualification_gd_diff"
)


world_cup_2026_data <- wc26_matches |>
  select(
    tournament_id,
    year,
    match_id,
    match_date,

    home_team_code,
    home_team_name,
    away_team_code,
    away_team_name,

    home_team_score,
    away_team_score,

    all_of(
      predictors
    ),

    match_result
  ) |>
  mutate(
    split =
      "Testing"
  )


# ============================================================
# CLEAN HISTORICAL MODELING DATA
# ============================================================

historical_model_data <- historical_data |>
  mutate(
    match_result =
      case_when(

        home_team_score >
          away_team_score ~
          "Home Win",

        home_team_score <
          away_team_score ~
          "Away Win",

        TRUE ~
          "Draw"
      ),

    split =
      if_else(
        year <= 2018,
        "Training",
        "Testing"
      )
  ) |>
  select(
    tournament_id,
    year,
    match_id,
    match_date,

    home_team_code,
    home_team_name,
    away_team_code,
    away_team_name,

    home_team_score,
    away_team_score,

    all_of(
      predictors
    ),

    match_result,
    split
  )


# ============================================================
# COMBINE 1990-2022 + 2026
# ============================================================

world_cup_final <- bind_rows(
  historical_model_data,
  world_cup_2026_data
) |>
  mutate(
    match_result =
      factor(
        match_result,
        levels = c(
          "Home Win",
          "Draw",
          "Away Win"
        )
      )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    year,
    match_date,
    match_id
  )


# ============================================================
# FINAL TESTS
# ============================================================

# 2026 should have 104 matches
nrow(
  world_cup_2026_data
)


# Full dataset should have 656 matches
nrow(
  world_cup_final
)


# Expected tournament counts
world_cup_final |>
  count(
    year,
    split
  )


# Missing predictors
world_cup_final |>
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(
        predictors
      ),
      ~ sum(is.na(.))
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "predictor",
    values_to = "missing"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(missing)
  )


# Duplicate matches
world_cup_final |>
  count(
    year,
    match_id
  ) |>
  filter(
    n > 1
  )
```

```{r}
write_csv(
  world_cup_final,
  "data/world_cup_pre_tournament_predictors.csv"
)
```
